hpi: The patient is a 60-year-old female with vaginal itching. Atrophic vaginitis is a common condition in postmenopausal women. It is important to consider the underlying causes of vaginal symptoms. This patient should be educated on the use of vaginal moisturizers and lubricants to help with sexual intercourse due to vaginal atrophy. Hormonal therapy may also be considered if the vaginal atrophy is more severe.
